30th-127.name: Switch
30th-127.effect: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Call Sign
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

me01-114.name: Boss's Orders
me01-114.effect: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

me01-125.name: Rare Candy
me01-125.effect: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it, skipping the Stage 1. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn.

me01-167.name: Buddy-Buddy Poffin
me01-167.effect: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

me01-173.name: Night Stretcher
me01-173.effect: Put a Pokémon or a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.

abilities.name: Agile
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon has no Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Hadron Spark
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 120 more damage.

abilities.name: Fairy Zone
abilities.effect: The Weakness of each of your opponent's {N} Pokémon in play is now {P}. (Apply Weakness as ×2.)

attacks.name: Full Moon Rondo
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

abilities.name: Adrena-Brain
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon has any {D} Energy attached, you may move up to 3 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

abilities.name: Flip the Script
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Flip the Script Ability each turn.

attacks.name: Cruel Arrow
attacks.effect: This attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Recon Directive
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck.

attacks.name: Phantom Dive
attacks.effect: Put 6 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

abilities.name: Psychic Embrace
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic {P} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your {P} Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. You can't use this Ability on a Pokémon that would be Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Miracle Force
attacks.effect: This Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.

sv01-166.name: Arven
sv01-166.effect: Search your deck for an Item card and a Pokémon Tool card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv01-169.name: Defiance Band
sv01-169.effect: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, the attacks of the Pokémon this card is attached to do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

sv01-170.name: Electric Generator
sv01-170.effect: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and attach up to 2 Basic {L} Energy cards you find there to your Benched {L} Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

sv01-181.name: Nest Ball
sv01-181.effect: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv01-182.name: Pal Pad
sv01-182.effect: Shuffle up to 2 Supporter cards from your discard pile into your deck.

sv01-189.name: Professor's Research
sv01-189.effect: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.

abilities.name: Squawk and Seize
abilities.effect: Once during your first turn, you may discard your hand and draw 6 cards. You can't use more than 1 Squawk and Seize Ability during your turn.

attacks.name: Motivate
attacks.effect: Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

sv02-171.name: Artazon
sv02-171.effect: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Basic Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box and put it onto their Bench. Then, that player shuffles their deck. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

sv02-173.name: Bravery Charm
sv02-173.effect: The Basic Pokémon this card is attached to gets +50 HP.

sv02-185.name: Iono
sv02-185.effect: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, each player draws a card for each of their remaining Prize cards.

sv02-188.name: Super Rod
sv02-188.effect: Shuffle up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

sv02-190.name: Jet Energy
sv02-190.effect:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon, switch that Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Infernal Reign
abilities.effect: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Basic {R} Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Burning Darkness
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.

abilities.name: Quick Search
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Quick Search Ability each turn.

attacks.name: Blustery Wind
attacks.effect: You may discard a Stadium in play.

sv03-196.name: Town Store
sv03-196.effect: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Pokémon Tool card, reveal it, and put it into their hand. Then, that player shuffles their deck.

attacks.name: Amp You Very Much
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 1 more Prize card.

sv04-160.name: Counter Catcher
sv04-160.effect:
You can use this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.

Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

sv04-163.name: Earthen Vessel
sv04-163.effect:
You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.

Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv04-178.name: Technical Machine: Evolution

attacks.name: Evolution
attacks.effect: Choose up to 2 of your Benched Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv04-178.effect: The Pokémon this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.) If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your turn.

sv05-157.name: Prime Catcher
sv05-157.effect: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

sv05-159.name: Rescue Board
sv05-159.effect: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is {C} less. If that Pokémon's remaining HP is 30 or less, it has no Retreat Cost.

sv06.5-060.name: Neutralization Zone
sv06.5-060.effect:
Prevent all damage done to Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box (both yours and your opponent's) by attacks from the opponent's Pokémon ex and Pokémon V. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

This card can't be put into your hand or deck from the discard pile.

sv07-131.name: Area Zero Underdepths
sv07-131.effect:
Each player who has any Tera Pokémon in play can have up to 8 Pokémon on their Bench.

If a player no longer has any Tera Pokémon in play, that player discards Pokémon from their Bench until they have 5. When this card leaves play, both players discard Pokémon from their Bench until they have 5, and the player who played this card discards first.

sv07-132.name: Briar
sv07-132.effect:
You can use this card only if your opponent has exactly 2 Prize cards remaining.

During this turn, if your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack used by your Tera Pokémon, take 1 more Prize card.

sv07-142.name: Sparkling Crystal
sv07-142.effect: When the Tera Pokémon this card is attached to uses an attack, that attack costs 1 Energy less. (The Energy can be of any type.)
